_about: 2026-10-08 claim fixes on the Skin Solutions pages (plan step 1.4a; Malcolm: 'Fix the issues the research found'). Five phrases the registers forbid were live; the English replacements below are grounded in docs/claims/argireline-acetyl-hexapeptide-8.md §1 claim 8 and §3, docs/claims/matrixyl-3000.md §1 claim 1 and §4, docs/claims/copper-peptide-ghk-cu.md 'Claims to AVOID', docs/claims/pdrn.md (Ye 2026), and the rule that trial magnitudes stay off product and concern pages. Locale values: configs/claim-fixes/concern-pages-2026-10-08.<loc>.json (one translator per locale, minimal substitution into the live locale text). Assembled into set-only specs configs/hub-upgrades/<page>-claim-fixes-2026-10-08.json and applied with scripts/hub-upgrade.py. Undo: --rollback per spec.

changes.old_fragment: slow, prevent, and even reverse them
changes.new_fragment: slow their progress and soften how they look
changes.why: 'reverse' promises an outcome; the registers allow the look of lines softened

changes.new: How well tolerated is Acetyl Hexapeptide-8?
changes.why: 'safe for sensitive skin' needs product-level evidence we do not have (Argireline register §3)

changes.new: In the controlled studies of the ingredient it was well tolerated: no one dropped out, and no redness, stinging, peeling or itching was reported with twice-daily use. It is not an acid or a retinoid. Our serum has not had a tolerance study of its own, so patch-test first and stop if stinging or redness does not settle.
changes.why: Argireline register §1 claim 8 and §4 (Wang 2013, Raikou 2017); no 'gentlest', no 'no parabens' (EC Annex III), no comparison with retinoids

changes.new: Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) Night Cream - Night-Time Support for Firmer-Looking Skin
changes.why: 'structural repair' is a repair claim on the copper avoid list

changes.new: No. The clinical study behind Matrixyl® 3000 was run on women aged 42 to 67, and in that group the look of deep wrinkles was visibly reduced over 2 months (manufacturer study). Starting earlier gives more years of prevention, but the look of firmer, smoother skin can be supported at any age.
changes.why: 'stimulation of new collagen production' is a physiological action (Matrixyl register §4); the −39% figure stays on the hub (in-vivo magnitudes rule)

changes.new: Retinol is a vitamin A derivative that speeds up skin turnover; PDRN and GHK-Cu work differently, supporting the look of renewed, revitalised skin. In the one head-to-head study (31 women, 28 days, double-blind), the PDRN side showed a clearly larger improvement in the look of crow's feet than the retinol side, and both sides were well tolerated. The full figures are on the PDRN research page. Both can be combined with retinol if you wish.
changes.why: the multiple ('more than twice') stays on the hub; the retinol-irritation sentence was unsupported (Ye 2026 reported no adverse reactions on the retinol side); translated hrefs carry the locale prefix
